title: Argus
description: (almost) Full OptiFine resource pack compatibility for Sodium. CTM, custom sky, animations, CIT, custom GUI, custom colors and more - one mod, nothing else needed.
body:
# Argus

Argus is a Sodium-native Fabric client mod for OptiFine resource-pack compatibility on the modern Minecraft renderer path.

No bridge mod, no wrapper layer, no old renderer detour: Argus implements supported OptiFine-style resource-pack features directly where they render.

[![View Source Code on GitHub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Modding-Forge/mf-nexus-modpage-assets/main/buttons/view_source_code_on_github.png)](https://github.com/Modding-Forge/argus)
[![Join us on Discord](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Modding-Forge/mf-nexus-modpage-assets/main/buttons/join_us_on_discord.png)](https://discord.gg/pqEHdWDf8z)

Argus is currently in **stable beta**. The core systems work in-game, most supported OptiFine pack features should work with existing packs, and compatibility bugs are being fixed against real-world packs as they show up.

## Requirements

* Minecraft `26.2`
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Sodium

## Features

Implemented or actively usable:

* Connected Textures:
  * compact CTM
  * horizontal
  * vertical
  * top
  * fixed
  * random
  * repeat
  * layered methods
  * overlays
  * atlas tile injection
* Built-in regular-glass CTM resource pack
* Better Grass and Better Snow
* Emissive textures for block and CTM textures
* Custom Item Textures for `type=item`
* Custom GUI textures for OptiFine-style container rules
* Custom Animations MVP for block-atlas texture animation rules
* Custom Colors and Colormaps
* Custom Sky layers
* Natural Textures via `optifine/natural.properties`
* OptiFine Extra Options scope
* OptiFine-scope Entity Textures:
  * random entities
  * random tile entities
  * paintings
  * chest and shulker hooks
  * layer synchronization
  * emissive companions
* Sodium settings integration for Argus features and visual controls
* ETF & EMF compatibility
* Dynamic Lighting mod compatibility

## Compatibility Warning
Not compatible with:
* Sodium Extra & simillar
* OptiFine
* Other OF alternative mods except Dynamic Lighting

ETF and EMF are **supported exceptions**:
* When **ETF** is installed, Argus disables its overlapping entity texture features and greys out the related settings.
* **EMF** remains the intended mod for entity models and entity animations, which Argus does not implement.

## Entity Textures, ETF, and EMF

Entity texture features are included for the OptiFine scope.
Entity model and entity animation packs are not included. Use **EMF/ETF** for that stack.
When **ETF** is installed, Argus disables its overlapping entity texture features and greys out the related settings.

Argus does **not** implement:
* Entity model replacement
* Entity animation packs, including Fresh Animations-style CEM
